decision: Qualify TQP-33 for the retained bounded Windows independent geometry and topology oracle suite over native world-transvoxel assemblies without widening the claim to arbitrary overlap, randomized fields, or dynamic terrain.
alternatives_considered: continue treating the implementation's existing seam and topology helpers as sufficient independent evidence
defer independent checks until randomized terrain generation
accept screenshots as geometry correctness evidence
separate native buffer acquisition from a pure triangle-soup oracle and prove every detector with an injected defect
evidence: five retained LOD0, LOD2, closed, open, and mixed-LOD native assemblies with 74 cold/warm direct chunk calls

thirteen independent checks for indices, finite values, bounds, degeneracy, edge multiplicity, nonmanifold edges, exact duplicate overlap, orientation, components, Euler characteristic, ray parity, signed volume, and field resampling
thirteen injected controls, one designated defect detected by every required check
window-relative millionth-sample-unit topology keys and measured maximum native fixed-point field residual of 0.03125 density units under a 0.0313 ceiling
debug performance distributions, retained and peak memory, workload provenance, minimized fixture runners, and exact cold/warm signatures
qualified_scope: independent triangle-soup checks over the five retained native assemblies
closed genus-zero Euler, ray-parity, signed-volume, and authoritative field-resampling checks where declared applicable
declared exterior-plane classification for retained open assemblies
source-level separation from the existing native evidence validator and native mesher
one detected injected negative control per independent check
unqualified_scope: partial coplanar overlap beyond exact coincident triangles
arbitrary fields, topology, LOD arrangements, coordinates, platforms, or native build profiles
adversarial randomized and minimized failing native corpora reserved for TQP-34
dynamic publication, edits, streaming, rendering, collision, navigation, persistence, and production performance
review: Focused fixtures, source independence, exact retained signatures, every positive check, every designated injected negative, field residual bounds, performance telemetry, full program regression, smoke tests, and editor capture inspection passed.
downstream_impact: TQP-34 becomes the next dependency-ordered milestone. Gate E remains closed. No world-transvoxel source or binary change was required.
